line.a_chowany.text: Let's play hide-and-seek! Bear seeks and we hide.

line.a_licze.text: I'm closing my eyes and counting to three!

line.a_nie_widac.text: I've shut my eyes, so nobody can see me!

line.a_widze.text: I can see you, Bunny! You're standing in front of the bush.

line.a_przed.text: Bunny, when you stand in front of the bush, everybody can see you. Even with your eyes shut.

line.a_pokaz.text: Look at the duckling. She's standing in front of the bush, so you can see all of her.

line.a_za.text: And now she's behind the bush, at the back. The bush covers her, and you can only see her head.

line.a_rozumiem.text: I see! You have to stand behind the bush. I'm off to find a good hiding place!

line.a_schowaj_mysz.text: Mouse wants to hide too. Drag her behind the bush.

line.a_mysz_nie.text: Bear would see her here at once. Hide Mouse behind the bush.

line.a_mysz_ok.text: I can only see her ears! Mouse is behind the bush.

line.a_szukaj.text: Help me look! See what's peeking out from behind the hiding places.

line.a_gdzie_zajac.text: Where is Bunny hiding? Point to his hiding place.

line.a_gdzie_zajac_nie.text: He's not there. Look for long ears.

line.a_mam_zajaca.text: Got you, Bunny! Only your ears were peeking out.

line.a_gdzie_kaczka.text: And now point to where the duckling is hiding.

line.a_gdzie_kaczka_nie.text: She's not there. Look for a little yellow head.

line.a_znalezione.text: The duckling's found too! Her little yellow head was peeking out.

line.a_wracam.text: This time I stood at the back, but my ears gave me away!

line.a_jeszcze.text: Once more! This time we'll hide so well that nothing peeks out.

line.a_sluchaj.text: Then I'll listen. When someone calls, point to the bush the voice comes from.

line.a_po_glosie.text: We found you by your voices! Now let's go to the meadow.

line.b_zabawa.text: This is Mouse's little house! Let's play in front and behind next to it.

line.b_przed.text: Put the teddy in front of the house.

line.b_przed_nie.text: In front of the house means at the front, where the door is.

line.b_przed_ok.text: The teddy is in front of the house. You can see all of him!

line.b_za.text: And now hide the teddy behind the house.

line.b_za_nie.text: Behind the house means at the back. The house should cover him.

line.b_za_ok.text: Behind the house! Only his head peeks out.

line.b_co_przed.text: Point to what is in front of the house.

line.b_co_przed_nie.text: She's behind the house, hidden. What stands at the front?

line.b_co_przed_ok.text: Yes, the ball is in front of the house, and you can see all of it.

line.b_co_za.text: And now point to who is hiding behind the house.

line.b_co_za_nie.text: The ball lies at the front. Who's peeking out from behind the house?

line.b_koniec.text: The ball in front of the house, the hen behind it!

line.c_gdzie_mysz.text: Wait, where is Mouse? She hid again, and I can't see her anywhere!

line.c_zdjecie.text: I took a photo while everyone was hiding! Let's look at it. Maybe the photo shows where Mouse is.

line.c_zdjecie_gdzie.text: Where is Mouse hiding in the photo? Point to her.

line.c_zdjecie_nie.text: She isn't there. Look for little grey ears peeking out somewhere.

line.c_zdjecie_tak.text: Behind the hedge! The hen stands in front of the bench, so we can see all of her. But of Mouse we see only her ears, because the hedge hides her.

line.c_ogrod.text: I know that hedge! It grows in the garden with the maze. Let's go there!

line.c_labirynt.text: Oh my, what a big hedge maze! Mouse is somewhere inside, behind the hedges.

line.c_za_duzy.text: I'm too big. I won't fit between the hedges.

line.c_ide.text: I'm small, I'll go! I'll go in through that green arch.

line.c_prowadz.text: Lead me through the maze to Mouse. I start at the bottom, and Mouse is waiting at the top.

line.c_znaleziona.text: Hedgehog found Mouse! She was hiding behind the hedge, so nobody could see her.

line.c_koniec.text: Everyone is found! The best way to hide is behind something. In front, everybody can see you.

line.c_rewanz.text: Come to my house! We'll play once more, and this time I'll hide so well that Bear won't find me!

line.p_start.text: Let's play in front and behind! I have a few games for you.

line.p_mysz_nie.text: Mouse must be hidden, behind the box.

line.p_mysz_ok.text: Yes, Mouse is behind the box. Only her ears show!

line.p_kaczka.text: Put the duckling in front of the basket.

line.p_kaczka_nie.text: In front of the basket, so she can be seen.

line.p_kaczka_ok.text: Yes, the duckling stands in front of the basket. You can see all of her!

line.p_kto.text: Who is hiding behind the bush? Look at what's peeking out and point.

line.p_kto_nie.text: Look again at what is peeking out from behind the bush.

line.p_kto_zajac.text: Yes, it's the bunny! His long ears were peeking out.

line.p_kto_kura.text: Yes, it's the hen! Her red comb was peeking out.

line.p_fotel.text: Point to what is in front of the armchair.

line.p_fotel_nie.text: The teddy is hiding behind the armchair. What is at the front?

line.p_fotel_ok.text: Yes, the block is in front of the armchair. And the teddy is hiding behind it.

line.p_glaz.text: Hide the bunny behind the big stone.

line.p_glaz_nie.text: The bunny must be hidden, behind the stone.

line.p_glaz_ok.text: Yes, the bunny is behind the stone. The stone covers him.

line.h_dom.text: Welcome to my house! Let's play once more. Now I know how to hide.

line.h_przytulanka.text: My teddy is hiding too. He's shut his eyes, so nobody can see him!

line.h_znowu.text: Bunny, again? The teddy is in front of the armchair, at the front, so everybody can see him.

line.h_ojej.text: Oops, I did the same thing as in the forest!

line.h_schowaj.text: Help him: hide the teddy behind the armchair.

line.h_schowaj_nie.text: Behind the armchair, at the back. The armchair should cover him.

line.h_schowany.text: Behind the armchair! Now only his ears show.

line.h_licze.text: My turn! I'm closing my eyes and counting. One, two, three!

line.h_szukam.text: Looking, looking... Where is Bunny? I can't see him anywhere!

line.h_gdzie.text: Help me: point to where Bunny is hiding.

line.h_gdzie_nie.text: He's not there. Look for something peeking out.

line.h_za_zaslona.text: Behind the curtain! Only your feet were peeking out, Bunny.

line.h_wygralem.text: I hid behind the curtain, at the back, and Bear looked for me for a long time!

line.h_pilka.text: Now let's tidy up. Put the ball and the block on the rug, in front of the armchair, so everybody can see them.

line.h_pilka_nie.text: Onto the rug, in front of the armchair.

line.h_dobrze.text: The ball and the block are in front of the armchair. You can see all of them!

line.h_obrazki.text: I drew our day for my mum, but the pictures got mixed up.

line.h_obrazki_uloz.text: Put the pictures in order, starting with what happened first.

line.h_obrazki_nie.text: Look again at what happened first and what came next.

line.h_obrazki_ok.text: First I stood in front of the bush, then I hid behind it, and at the end Hedgehog found Mouse!

line.h_gra.text: Now I hide Mouse, and Bunny guesses.

line.h_gra_zgaduje.text: Mouse is behind the box! I can see her ears. And the ball is in front of the box.

line.h_rodzice.text: Play this with your parents: one hides a toy, the other looks for it and says if it is in front of something or behind it.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for playing hide-and-seek! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the bush Mouse hid behind. We got it when we learnt what is in front and what is behind.
